1. Heard Sri Manoj Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the applicants in both the applications as well
as Sri S.K. Singh, learned Aga for the State-opposite parties and Sri Mohammad Azam holding brief
of Sri Om Prakash Shukla, for the opposite parties in both the applications.
2.

Both the applications have been preferred seeking to quash the entire proceedings of the case No.
98873 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 376, 377, 354, 420 IPC and 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S.
Cholapur, District Varanasi, arising out of Case Crime No. 0431 of 2022 under Sections 498A, 323,
504, 506, 376, 377, 354, 420 IPC and 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Cholapur, District Varanasi, pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-I, District Varanasi as well as cognizance order dated 19.08.2023 taken by the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, District Varanasi.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-I, District Varanasi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
However, the learned counsel for the applicants submits on the strength of the averments contained in the supplementary affidavit Annexure-SA-2 at page 33 reference whereof at paragraph No. 4 that with respect to the leading application compromise application stood submitted before the court below on 15.10.2024 and as regards the connected application the same also stood filed on 15.10.2024. Learned counsel for the applicants, thus, submits that the direction be issued for verification and till that time interim protection be accorded.
3.

Learned AGA as well as learned counsel for the opposite party No. 2 submit that there appears to be a compromise application filed in both the applications before the court below, thus, direction be issued to verify the same.

4. Considering the said submission, the application stands disposed of directing the applicants to appear before the court below on 28.02.2025 along with the self attested copy of the present application.

On the receipt of the same, the court below shall make endeavour to put to notice the other party and thereafter verify the compromise application as alleged to have been filed by the applicant by 15.10.2024, verification be done by 16.04.2025.
5.

Till the verification is done in the compromise application so submitted by the parties, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in the proceedings of the case No. 98873 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 376, 377, 354, 420 IPC and 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Cholapur, District Varanasi, arising out of Case Crime No. 0431 of 2022 under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 376, 377,
354, 420 IPC and 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Cholapur, District Varanasi, pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-I, District Varanasi as well as cognizance order dated 19.08.2023 taken by the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, District Varanasi.
